defensiveAbilities.name: Pest Haven
defensiveAbilities.description:
The rotting hides and molding straw stuffing of skitterstitches are ideal nesting grounds for vermin and insect swarms. Any animal swarm sharing a space with a skitterstitch gains fast healing 3.

Additionally, if a creature deals at least 10 piercing or slashing damage to the skitterstitchstitch, the swarm can use its swarming bites Strike (or similar attack) against the attacker as a reaction.

Effect: Pest Haven

defensiveAbilities.name: Spider Swarm Host
defensiveAbilities.description: Skitterstitches host a Spider Swarm within themselves, which erupts out when the Skitterstitch is destroyed

offensiveAbilities.name: Flay
offensiveAbilities.description: The skitterstitch makes a blade Strike against an animal or humanoid. On a success, the skitterstitch slices a long strip of flesh from the target; if the skitterstitch dealt damage, it deals an additional 1d6 persistent bleed damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Skitterstitch Venom
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 23 Fortitude Saving Throw

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 1d10 Poison Damage damage, Off-Guard, and Clumsy 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 1d10 Poison Damage damage, off-guard, and Clumsy 2 (1 round)

offensiveAbilities.name: Stitch Skin
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The skitterstitch hasn't used this ability since the last time it successfully used its Flay ability

Effect The skitterstitch sews flayed flesh to its body to seal tears and rents. The skitterstitch regains 8 Healing Damage Hit Points.
